newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber futures end firmer on yen's decline.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber futures end firmer on yen's decline.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Tuesday, as the yen's decline against the dollar stimulated moderate short-covering, the traders said.
The market ignored the news that Goodyear Tire & Rubber's union said contract talks would resume on Tuesday.

Prices ranged from 0.8 yen to 3.1 yen per kg higher. Benchmark September was up 1.2 yen. Caution that prices were too low after recent sharp falls, also prompted investors to cover their shorts, particularly in nearby months.
